# viettelcloud_server (Resource)

Manage a Viettel Cloud server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "viettelcloud_vpc" "example" {
  name   = "server-example-vpc"
  cidr   = "10.0.0.0/16"
  region = "vn-central-1"
}

resource "viettelcloud_subnet" "example" {
  name   = "server-example-subnet"
  cidr   = "10.0.1.0/24"
  vpc_id = viettelcloud_vpc.example.id
}

resource "viettelcloud_server" "example" {
  name = "example-server"
  zone = "vn-central-1a"

  flavor = {
    kind   = "custom"
    family = "basic"
    vcpus  = 2
    ram    = 2
  }

  boot = {
    boot_type   = "image"
    image       = "ubuntu-22.04-publiccloud"
    volume_type = "Ceph_HDD_1A_10K"
    volume_size = 30
  }

  private_ips = [{
    kind      = "subnet"
    subnet_id = viettelcloud_subnet.example.id
  }]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `boot` (Attributes) Boot configuration. Supported boot types are image, custom_image, local_disk, and volume. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--boot))
- `flavor` (Attributes) Predefined or custom server flavor. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--flavor))
- `name` (String) Server name.

### Optional

- `bandwidth` (Number) Server bandwidth in Mbps. The backend enforces the supported range and rejects a value below its minimum, so omit it to accept the backend default.
- `data_volumes` (Attributes List) Data volumes created and attached with the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_volumes))
- `description` (String) Optional server description. Omitting it preserves the backend value; set an empty string to clear it.
- `elastic_ips` (Attributes List) Elastic IP attachments. kind existing attaches an IP; kind new creates an IP. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--elastic_ips))
- `key_pair_id` (String) Key pair ID (UUID) associated with the server.
- `placement_group_id` (String) Placement group ID (UUID) associated with the server.
- `power_state` (String) Desired power state. Supported values are running and shutdown.
- `private_ips` (Attributes List) Private IP attachments. kind subnet creates an IP; kind ip attaches an existing IP. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--private_ips))
- `quantity` (Number) Number of servers to create. A Terraform server resource manages exactly one server, so only 1 is supported.
- `security_group_ids` (Set of String) Security group IDs attached to the server. Configure an empty set to detach all security groups.
- `user_data` (String, Sensitive) Cloud-init user data.
- `zone` (String) Exact project zone name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `data_volume_ids` (List of String) Attached data volume IDs.
- `id` (String) Server ID (UUID).
- `key_pair_name` (String) Key pair name associated with the server.
- `placement_group_name` (String) Placement group name associated with the server.
- `server_type` (String) Backend server type.
- `status` (String) Current lifecycle status.

<a id="nestedatt--boot"></a>
### Nested Schema for `boot`

Required:

- `boot_type` (String) Boot source type.

Optional:

- `custom_image_id` (String) Custom image ID (UUID).
- `delete_on_termination` (Boolean) Delete the boot volume after deleting the server. Defaults to true for boot types image and custom_image, and to false for boot type volume.
- `image` (String) Exact image name. Required for image and local_disk boot types.
- `iops` (Number) Requested boot volume IOPS. The backend allocates a value when it is omitted.
- `volume_id` (String) Existing boot volume ID (UUID).
- `volume_size` (Number) Server-created boot volume size in GB. Updates can only increase it.
- `volume_type` (String) Exact volume type name. Required for image and custom_image boot types.


<a id="nestedatt--flavor"></a>
### Nested Schema for `flavor`

Required:

- `kind` (String) Flavor kind: predefined or custom.

Optional:

- `family` (String) Custom flavor family: basic, premium, enterprise, gpu, or spot.
- `name` (String) Exact predefined flavor name.
- `ram` (Number) Custom flavor RAM in GiB.
- `vcpus` (Number) Custom flavor virtual CPU count.


<a id="nestedatt--data_volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data_volumes`

Required:

- `volume_size` (Number) Server-created data volume size in GB. Updates can only increase it.
- `volume_type` (String) Exact volume type name.

Optional:

- `delete_on_termination` (Boolean) Delete this data volume after deleting the server. Defaults to true. Removing it from configuration preserves the last applied value instead of restoring the default.
- `iops` (Number) Requested volume IOPS. The backend allocates a value when it is omitted.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Attached data volume ID (UUID).


<a id="nestedatt--elastic_ips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `elastic_ips`

Required:

- `kind` (String) Attachment kind: existing or new.

Optional:

- `delete_on_termination` (Boolean) Delete this elastic IP after deleting the server or removing the attachment from configuration. Defaults to true for kind new and false for kind existing.
- `enable_ipv4` (Boolean) Enable IPv4 when kind is new. Defaults to true.
- `enable_ipv6` (Boolean) Enable IPv6 when kind is new. Defaults to false.
- `id` (String) Elastic IP ID. Required when kind is existing; computed when kind is new.

Read-Only:

- `ip_address` (String)
- `ipv6_address` (String)
- `status` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--private_ips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `private_ips`

Required:

- `kind` (String) Attachment kind: subnet or ip.

Optional:

- `delete_on_termination` (Boolean) Delete this private IP after deleting the server or removing the attachment from configuration. Defaults to true for kind subnet and false for kind ip.
- `id` (String) Private IP ID. Required when kind is ip; computed when kind is subnet.
- `subnet_cidr` (String) Exact subnet CIDR. Configure exactly one of subnet_id or subnet_cidr when kind is subnet.
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet ID. Configure exactly one of subnet_id or subnet_cidr when kind is subnet.

Read-Only:

- `ip_address` (String)
- `mac_address` (String)
